payload.claim: The "Existing tests" note's instruction to compare `[str(d) for d in ...]` instead of a raw defect list is general rather than enumerated: besides criterion 7's named witness, at least eight more pre-existing, unnamed assertions in tests/test_spec_citations.py and one in tests/test_spec_loop_driver.py compare a raw list against `citation_defects`/`citation_count_and_defects`'s return value directly and will fail at head unless each is individually updated the same way, and missing one surfaces only as an ordinary `tests`-gate failure rather than pointing at this cause.
